input.text: Hermes is the owner's messaging agent. It runs on the mac mini and talks to Telegram. Each message becomes a session; cheap models handle triage while Opus handles planning. The gateways broker credentials so the session never sees provider keys.

The research-gateway deploys by a git poller on the mini. Every two minutes it checks master, waits for the CI check run on that SHA to be green, and then restarts the LaunchAgent. A SIGTERM drains running jobs for up to thirty minutes before the process exits. Rollback is a revert commit.

Der Hausmeister hat gestern den Heizungskeller geprüft und festgestellt, dass die Umwälzpumpe ausgetauscht werden muss. Die Reparatur soll nächste Woche stattfinden, die Bewohner werden per Aushang informiert. Warmwasser steht während des Austauschs für etwa vier Stunden nicht zur Verfügung.

Bun 1.4 ships a faster bundler and native support for running TypeScript files directly. Node 26 can also strip types from TypeScript files without a build step, so small tools no longer need ts-node or tsx. The remaining differences are import extensions, which must be written out, and a few unsupported syntax features such as enums.
